digests.name: The Week Ahead Outlook
digests.subject: The Week Ahead Outlook - October 5 - October 11, 2026

issues.where: MON, OCT 5 · 4:00 PM — Ouray County BOCC Special Joint Work Session AND City of Ouray · Ouray City Council Work Session
issues.quote: MON, OCT 5 · 4:00 PM Ouray County … MON, OCT 5 · 4:00 PM City of Ouray · Ouray City Council Work Session
issues.problem: The joint work session is listed as two separate meetings at the same time (4:00 PM, Oct 5) — the BOCC Special Joint Work Session and the Ouray City Council Work Session — but the body text of each makes clear they are the same single joint meeting. This will confuse readers into thinking there are two separate 4:00 PM meetings when there is one.
issues.suggestion: Merge into a single listing (e.g., 'Ouray County BOCC & Ouray City Council Special Joint Work Session') or clearly label one as the joint session and remove the duplicate standalone entry.

issues.where: WED, OCT 7 · 10:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Village Town Council Meeting — 'Why This Matters' box
issues.quote: The gondola (built 1996) is critical regional infrastructure … leaving a significant funding gap.
issues.problem: The 'Why This Matters' gondola blurb appears inside the Mountain Village Town Council budget work session entry but the gondola is not mentioned anywhere in that meeting's agenda description. The same blurb also appears under the SMART Board item (Thu, Oct 8), where it is relevant. It appears to be misplaced boilerplate inserted into the wrong meeting entry.
issues.suggestion: Remove the gondola 'Why This Matters' box from the Mountain Village Town Council entry; it belongs only under the SMART Board listing.

issues.where: ★ Festival This Week — Telluride Horror Show
issues.problem: The festival is described as running October 9–12, which is four days, but passes are described as '3-day passes,' contradicting the listed run of four days.
issues.suggestion: Confirm the correct duration and reconcile: either change the dates to a 3-day span (e.g., Oct 10–12) or change the pass description to '4-day passes.'

issues.quote: the Telluride Town Council takes up two genuinely consequential items
issues.problem: In the recaps section, two entries use a bare 'Town Council' label without the town name in the short identifier line.
issues.suggestion: Change to 'Telluride Town Council' in each recap header to avoid ambiguity.

issues.where: Last Week's Meetings — WED, SEP 30 Town of Telluride · Town Council (Special)
issues.quote: Council met in special session to hear an appeal of the Planning and Zoning Commission's unanimous July 23 approval of a preliminary large-scale subdivision to consolidate two lots — Lot 34 and Lot 34B — into a single parcel at…
issues.problem: The sentence ends mid-thought with 'at…' — leftover placeholder text; the location or parcel address was never filled in.
issues.suggestion: Complete the sentence with the correct address or parcel description.

issues.where: WED, OCT 7 · 4:00 PM — Town of Telluride Ecology Commission
issues.quote: Regular public meeting — the agenda posts closer to the date on the Gov - Hub .
issues.problem: 'Gov - Hub' has erroneous spaces around the hyphen; should read 'GovHub' or 'Gov-Hub' per the platform's standard name, and the trailing space before the period is also present.
issues.suggestion: Change 'Gov - Hub' to 'GovHub' (or the correct styling) and remove the extra space.

issues.where: MON, OCT 5 · 4:00 PM — Town of Telluride Open Space Commission (body text)
issues.quote: the Bear Creek Preserve Zone 1 Restoration Pl an site walk
issues.problem: 'Pl an' contains an erroneous space in the middle of the word 'Plan.'

issues.where: Last Week's Meetings — TUE, SEP 29 Ouray County · BOCC
issues.problem: The recap summary starts mid-sentence with '6 million general fund deficit' — there is no subject or introductory clause; it reads as a broken/incomplete sentence.
issues.suggestion: Add an opening clause, e.g., 'Commissioners discussed a projected $6 million general fund deficit.'

issues.quote: The Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee meets to catch up on draft minutes from the summer
issues.problem: The intro says 'draft minutes from the summer' but the meeting listing specifies 'three months of draft minutes from June, July, and August' — June through August is technically still summer, but readers looking at the newsletter in October may expect 'summer' to mean something more recent; more importantly the intro omits that these are specifically June, July, and August minutes, which is not wrong but is slightly inconsistent with the detail in the body. (Minor consistency issue only.)
issues.suggestion: Match the intro language to the body: 'draft minutes from June, July, and August.'

issues.where: WED, OCT 7 📍 The Wright Opera House — A Monster Calls: Movie Night @ the Wright
issues.quote: WHEN? Wednesday, October 7 Doors at 6:30 PM Movie at 7:00 PM WHERE?
issues.problem: The listing contains raw template/form-field text ('WHEN?', 'WHERE?') that was never replaced with prose; 'WHERE?' is left unanswered.
issues.suggestion: Remove the 'WHEN?' and 'WHERE?' labels and replace with formatted event details, filling in the venue address for 'WHERE?'

issues.quote: What happened at 7 public meetings across the region last week
issues.problem: The body contains 7 meeting items, but one (Ouray County BOCC) is outside the newsletter's stated coverage area of Telluride, Mountain Village, Ridgway, Norwood, and San Miguel County. Ouray County is a different county entirely, making the 'across the region' framing misleading and the item potentially out of place.
issues.suggestion: Either remove the Ouray County BOCC item or note explicitly that coverage occasionally includes neighboring counties; adjust the count if the item is removed.

issues.where: TUE, SEP 29 Ouray County · BOCC — Sep 29, 2026
issues.problem: This is a broken sentence fragment with no subject or introductory verb — likely a placeholder or cut-and-paste error that was never completed into a full sentence.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite as a complete sentence, e.g., 'The board discussed a $6 million general fund deficit.'
